intro.text: A servant of the duke of Diggen's Point.

items.text: Flik went with the duke on the year-long voyage to marry Charlie off and saw Charlie ruin every match: being dull, talking religion, even being sick on a princess. Before Charlie was sent to the Midnight Sea, he gave Flik a ceramic cup for Tress. Back home, Flik slipped her its broken pieces and told her how Charlie had been sent to wed the Sorceress and been taken by her.

personality.text: Kind-hearted, and rather afraid of the duke.
